pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft, blurred edge gradients rather than sharp transitions. Patch area is maximal on the upper shoulder and cranial flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the caudal flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored inter-patch pathways forming triradiate and quadraradiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with noticeable widening at the ventral margin.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, continuous mane visible along the dorsal neck and shoulder with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette.
